annotations.title: Property fact sheet by field group

description:
The fact sheet for one UPRN as named field groups, at most 40 fields in all:
    `core` (type, beds, floor area with its source and confidence, tenure, year
    built, last sale date and price, flags), `lease` (term, unexpired years,
    short-lease flag), `energy` (EPC headline), `designations` (flood zone,
    heritage flags) and `owner_class` (class of owner; the name and company
    number only for a company or overseas entity, never a person). Default
    include is ["core"]. Cite the sale date when you quote a price.

    Use it after resolve_place gave a UPRN. Do NOT use it to estimate a value or
    for a whole area. `identity` says how precise the UPRN is: if it is not
    `unit` the record may describe a block. Floor area is often missing; say so.

    Everything is free except the `lease` group, which costs the price of
    property_lease and is charged only when a lease is returned. An empty
    group, `no_lease` or a failed group is not charged, and `cost_credits` in
    the reply is what was actually taken; a call with covered=false is free.
    Unknown groups are refused.
    Free. Keyed on a UPRN, not an address: call `address_autocomplete` (free) to narrow, then `address_resolve` to get one.
name: get_property
title: Property fact sheet by field group
